tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// rgyal po go pe la sras dang btsun mor bcas la shing mo yos sogs la gnang ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ dpal ldan sa gsum gsal mdzad pa// brtse ba'i bdag nyid thams cad mkhyen// 'jig rten kun skyob bla na med// rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig mngon mtho'i bde ba dang*// rnam grol bde ba bsgrub pa'i gzhi// mi dbang mchog 'di brtan bya'i phyir// rab tu shis pa'i tshig 'di brjod// dbang chen chu gter lhun po dang*// nyi ma zla ba rin chen lha'i// lha khyod yun ring zhabs brtan zhing*// bzhed don ma lus kun grub shog /lhag bsam kun nas rnam dag cing*// spyod pa'i phrin las rgya che ba// 'gro ba kun gyi rten gyur pa'i// sa chen khyod ni rgyal gyur cig /gting mtha' yas pa'i bsod nams chu// yon tan rin chen du mas gtams// blo gros klu dbang gis bsten pa'i// dpal ldan rgya mtsho rgyal gyur cig /rnam par dag pa'i rigs mtho zhing*// dpal 'byor dpag bsam shing gis brgyan// lha tshogs dkon mchog gus bsten pa// ri yi rgyal po rgyal gyur cig /dbang phyug brjed pa'i dkyil 'khor las// mthu stobs tsha zer rab 'phros pas// phas rgol mun pa'i tshogs 'joms pa// gsal byed khyod ni rgyal gyur cig /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba las// phan bde'i 'od zer rab bkye bas// dbul ba'i gdung ba sel byed pa// ri bong 'dzin khyod rgyal gyur cig /bsod nams rgya mtshor legs 'khrungs shing*// mdzes shing yid 'ong dag pa'i sku// bsten na dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba// yid bzhin nor bu rgyal gyur cig /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos rnams dang*// rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rgyal// srid las rnam rgyal bden pa'i mthus// rgyal byed tshig 'di 'grub gyur cig /rgyal sras rgyal bar bya ba'i phyir// tshul 'di tshul khrims rnam dag cing*// blo gsal blo gros 'jigs med pa// chos 'dzin chos smra 'phags pas sbyar// rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' go pe la bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/

shing mo yos kyi lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe sbyar ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs par 'khrungs// ye shes bzhi yi rin chen las grub cing*// phrin las bzhi yi bang rim mdzes pa can// rgyal po lhun po'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal// rnam dag yid kyi chu gtsang las 'khrungs pa'i// sdeb sbyor spel legs snyan tshig ze'u 'bru can// dge legs bcud ldan me tog phreng ba 'dis// mi dbang sras dang btsun mor bcas rnams mchod// rdo rje lta bur rab tu mkhregs pa dang*// pad+ma rgyas pa lta bur mdangs gsal zhing*// lha yi lus ltar yid du 'ong ba dang*// rig pa 'dzin ltar rtag tu nad med cing*// nyi ma bzhin du gzi brjid phun sum tshogs// lnga po de yis khyod sku bde legs shog /ka la piṅka'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa dang*// drang srong mchog ltar rtag tu bden par smra// kun dga'i rnga ltar chos kyi sgra sgrogs shing*// dbang phyug lta bur tshig gi mchog rab grub// 'brug gi sgra ltar sgra gzhan zil gyis gnon// lnga po de yis khyod gsung brgyan par shog /lhun po'i rgyal po lta bur brtan pa dang*// nam mkha' bzhin du shin tu rgya che zhing*// rgya mtsho lta bur rab tu zab pa dang*// dbyangs can lta bur blo mchog dang ldan zhing*// tshangs pa bzhin du tshad med bzhi dang ldan// lnga po de yis khyod thugs bde legs shog /mi g.yo'i khams ltar shin tu tshe ring zhing*// lha yi bla ma lta bur yon tan ldan// rnam thos bu ltar 'byor pa phun sum tshogs// yid bzhin nor ltar 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong*// 'khor los sgyur ltar phyogs las rnam par rgyal// lnga po de yis lha khyod 'byor par shog /tshogs can rab mchog lta bur tshul khrims dag /chos 'phags lta bur ting 'dzin mchog dang ldan// gsang bdag bzhin du mthu stobs rmad byung zhing*// spyan ras gzigs ltar snying rje'i ngang tshul can// 'jam dbyangs lta bur mkhyen rab phun sum tshogs// lnga po de yis mgon khyod rgyal gyur cig

/dpal ldan bla ma 'dren mchog bla na med// thub dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin// dam chos nges par 'byung ba mchog gi lam// dge 'dun tshogs mchog lha mis mchod pa'i gnas// de dag kun gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji skad smon lam btab pa 'grub par shog /mi dbang rgyal sras dpal ldan go pe la// sras dang btsun mo phun sum tshogs bya'i phyir// smon lam bzang po dpal ldan 'phags pas sbyar// dge ba gang des rgyal sras rgyal gyur cig /rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' yab sras btsun mo dang bcas pa la/ smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag chos smra ba'i btsun pa 'phags pa zhes bya bas sbyar nas/ me pho 'brug gi lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe/ bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir phul ba'o// smon lam gyi dngos gzhi rkang pa drug pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lags/ tshigs su bcad pa dgu mchis// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal gyi 'byung gnas srid gsum bla ma dngos grub gter// che ba'i che mchog lha mi rnams kyis gus btud pa// 'phags pa'i gtso bo thub dbang de dang dam pa'i chos// 'dus pa'i mchog gyur dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dad dang snying brtse rnam par 'byed pa'i glo gsal zhing*// bstan pa'i rtsa lag 'gro ba rnams kyi gnyen gcig po// bsod nams dbang phyug rgyal ba'i sras po go pe la// bde legs bya phyir rab tu shis pa'i tshig 'di brjod// bkra shis gang zhig ye shes rin chen las grub cing*// chos dbyings mkha' las legs par bshad pa'i 'od bkye bas// gdul bya'i pad+mo kun tu rgyas mdzad bla ma yi// bkra shis dam pa des kyang ding 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig tshogs gnyis dpal las byung gyur cig /thub pa'i dbang po sku gsum dpal 'byor lhun gyis grub// rang gzhan don brnyes bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/bkra shis gang zhig rkang gnyis dbang pos legs gsungs shing*// thog mtha' bar dge rnam par dkar la ma 'dres pa// zhi ba chags bral nges par 'byin pa dam chos kyi// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig kun mkhyen rgyal po'i rjes zhugs shing*// tshul khrims rnam dag yon tan rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// lha mi'i mchod gnas 'dus pa'i mchog gyur dge 'dun gyi// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam yas shing*// brtse ba'i dbang gis 'jig byed mi bzad skur bstan nas// bgegs tshogs kun 'joms rdo rje chos skyong thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /chos kyi rgyal po yon tan mthar phyin bden pa dang*// chos dbyings gang zhig 'dus ma byas pa'i bden pa dang*// rten cing 'brel 'byung sna tshogs mthu ldan bden pa yis// smon lam rnam dag ji skad btab bzhin 'grub par shog /rgyal ba'i sras po phyogs rnams kun nas rgyal bya'i phyir// phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po gang yin pas// bdag gis bsams bzhin legs par dgongs nas mgrin gcig tu// shis pa'i dbyangs sgra rnam kun mchog ldan sgrogs par shog /de skad smra de shākya'i brtul zhugs legs 'dzin pa// blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal ldan bzang po zhes bya yis// ltos 'phye'i dbang po'i gcig pa'i gcig la legs sbyar nas// mi yi dbang po go pe la la phul ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bkra shis las byung bkra shis kyis 'phags shing*// bkra shis lhun grub bkra shis dang tshul can// bkra shis mdzad pas bkra shis legs bsgrub pa// bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir rgyal// dpal ldan bkra shis dam pas yongs bzung zhing*// dpal 'byor bkra shis rmad byung 'od zer gyis// dpal gzhan zil gnon bkra shis rgyal byed pa// dpal khyod bkra shis du mas rgyal gyur cig

/rgyal ba kun gyi bkra shis gcig bsdus pa// chos rje rtag pa'i bkra shis gdul bya'i dpal// srid zhi'i bkra shis rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i gnas// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis yid 'ong dpal gyi sku mnga' ba// gsung dbyangs bkra shis yan lag drug cus brgyan// bkra shis mi 'gyur bde chen rol pa'i thugs// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gang zhig thos pas thog mar bkra shis shing*// nye bar bsams na gnas skabs bkra shis la// bsgoms na rtag pa'i bkra shis lhun grub pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshul khrims rnam dag bkra shis gzhi brtan zhing*// yon tan rin chen bkra shis gter gyis phyug /brtul zhugs bzang po'i bkra shis stobs 'chang ba// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis 'od 'bar rin chen las grub pa'i// bkra shis rgya mtsho rgyal bas bsten pa yi// zhing khams rgya mtsho bkra shis dge mtshan can// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'dod dgu'i bkra shis dpal gyis 'byor gyur zhing*// skye dgu'i bkra shis byed pa 'jig rten rje// lha yi mchog dang klu dbang bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bkra shis shog /bkra shis mchog gi bkra shis legs brjod pa'i// bkra shis de yi lha khyod bkra shis shing*// phyogs rnams dus kun shin tu bkra shis gang*// bzhed bzhin bkra shis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal sras bkra shis du mas rgyal bya'i phyir// bkra shis rmad byung bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung*// dam pa'i chos kyi bkra shis kyis mdzes pa// 'phags pa zhes byas bkra shis rnam par spel// rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' go pe la yab sras btsun mo dang bcas pa bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bkra shis kyi phreng ba rnam par spel ba zhes bya ba/

chos smra ba'i btsun pa 'phags pas nye bar bsdebs nas/ sa pho rta'i lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe phul ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i bkra shis bkra shis kyi dbang po zhes bya ba/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi zhabs pad ze'u 'bru'i phreng ldan lha dang lha min klu dbang gis// kun nas dga' ba'i gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer drwa bas cher gsal zhing*// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbus na legs bshad seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa// rgyal ba'i dbang po skye dgu'i sgron ma'i gsung rab dri med phyogs bcur rgyal// bkra shis rgya mtsho yon tan nor bu'i gter mnga' ba// gang gi dbang gi dbang phyug dam pa'i mchog gyur de'i// bkra shis rmad byung snyan ngag ngag gis legs brjod kyis// 'byung po gang dag phyogs 'dir lhags rnams gus pas nyon// gang gi zhing khams dri med 'dod yon bgrang yas shing*// 'phags mchog rnams dang 'gro bzangs dbang pos legs bsten pas// yon tan dpag tu med ces bya ba'i zhing khams kyi// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bdud bzhi las rgyal phun sum tshogs brnyes de bzhin gshegs// dgra bcom dbang po yang dag rdzogs pa rnam sangs rgyas// tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med ldan rnam nges pa// gzi brjid rgyal po'i bkra shis dam pas bde legs shog /gang gi 'od kyis zhing gi khyon kun gsal byed cing*// mtshan gyi dpal dang dpe byad bzang pos rnam par spras// pad+ma rā ga'i ri bo lta bur brjid pa'i sku'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshangs dbang dri za'i glu yis nye bar bsgrun min pa'i// gsung dbyangs rnam dag yan lag drug cus rab brgyan pa'i// dri med chos char rgya cher rab 'bebs gsung mchog gi /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/gdod nas rnam dag nyes tshogs tshang tshing nyer zhi zhing*// gzungs dang ting 'dzin mngon par shes pas mngon par rtsen// gzigs pa sgrib med thugs rjes rol pa'i thugs mnga' ba'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'gyur med tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med mnga' zhing*// yon tan rin chen phrin las gsal ba'i 'od rab 'byin// tshe yi dpal dang ye shes dam pa'i mchog stsol ba'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gsang sngags gang gis 'gro ba'i tshe 'dzin 'byor pa'i dpal// yid la 'dod dgu kun nas legs bsgrubs phun tshogs kyi// pha rol phyin byed gsung gi gsang ba legs bsdus pa'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'gro ba'i rtsa lag gzhan don dgyes pa'i ngang tshul can// rab tu dga' sogs sa bcu rnams la legs gnas pa'i// rgyal sras rnams dang rdul bral dgra bcom tshogs rnams kyi// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gang gis phrin las dge bas legs bsdus lha mchog dang*// grub pa rig 'dzin lha min mi dang klu dbang sogs// dpal 'byor gnyis kyi bde la dga' mgur longs spyod pa'i// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /rgyal ba'i dbang po tshe dang ye shes dpag med pa'i// gsang sngags dbang po 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor zhing bcas kyi// bkra shis dbang po snyan ngag ngag gis legs spel nas// mi yi dbang po dpal dang ldan la 'phags pas 'bul// tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i bkra shis bkra shis kyi dbang po zhes bya ba/ lcags mo bya'i lo gsar pa tshes pa'i tshe/ 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ 'gro ba'i bla ma yon tan rin chen gter// snyan pa'i 'od kyis sa gsum rab gsal ba'i// zhabs pad dri med spyi bos blangs byas nas// mchog tu shis par byed pa'i tshig 'di brjod// nad med pa dang tshe ring 'byor// dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa dang*// zhi ba'i ting 'dzin shes rab ste// drug po'i bkra shis gang lags pa// mkha' dang lhun po rgya mtsho dang*// nyi ma zla ba yid bzhin gyi// nor bu'i dpe dang rab mtshungs pa// kun nas shis par 'gyur ba gson// rang gi mngon par 'du byed rnam spangs shing*// 'du ba'i rdul gyis kun nas ma gos la// mi mthun phyogs kyi rkyen gyis mi rdzi ba// nam mkha' bzhin du rtag tu nad med shog

/gdod nas legs par bshad pa'i lhun stug cing*// logs par sgrub pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo la// mi nub mi 'gyur bskal pa'i bar gnas pa// lhun po ji bzhin tshe yang brtan gyur cig /zab cing rgya che'i 'byor pa mi zad pa// ma lus skye dgu'i nyer 'tsho nyid gyur cing*// sna tshogs phan bde'i chu 'dzin rab 'byin pa// rgya mtsho ji bzhin 'byor pas 'byor gyur cig /grol ba ngan pa'i smag rum rab 'joms shing*// 'gran zla ri bong 'dzin pa'i gzi bcom nas// snyan pa'i 'od zer phreng bas lham me ba// nyi ma ji bzhin dbang phyug phun tshogs shog /kun rtog drwa ba'i grwa zur nyer zhi zhing*// zag med bde ba dam pa'i ngang bsil ba// rtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rgyas gyur pa// zla rgyas ji bzhin ting 'dzin gyis zhir gyur// tshul dang tshul min 'byed pa'i 'od 'byin cing*// srid dang zhi ba'i dgos 'dod kun sgrub pa// bla na med pa'i rgyan gyi mchog gyur pa// rin chen ji bzhin shes rab mtshungs med shog /mngon mtho'i yan lag gnas yan lag /don kun grub pa'i yan lag ste// bzhi dang gcig gcig go rim bzhin// khyod la shis par 'gyur ba lags// shis par byed pa'i tshigs su bcad pa// yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba 'di// chu pho khyi'i lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe// 'phags pas sbyar nas mi'i dbang po la phul ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bde legs rgya mtsho dkon mchog rin chen la// dad pa rgya mtsho'i 'dun pas phyag 'tshal nas// skye dgu rgya mtsho'i dpal du gyur pa la// bkra shis rgya mtsho'i shis pa brjod par bya// dpal 'byor rgya mtsho yon tan nor bu'i gter// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes gcig bsdus pa// dngos grub rgya mtsho bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi// bkra shis rgya mtshos deng 'dir bkra shis shog /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal las 'khrungs gyur cing*// ye shes rgya mtsho gting mtha' rab yangs pa// kun mkhyen rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi// bkra shis rgya mtshos deng 'dir bkra shis shog

/gsung rab rgya mtsho rtogs pa dam pa yi// rin chen rgya mtsho'i gter gyi rten gyur pa// dam chos rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi// bkra shis rgya mtshos deng 'dir bkra shis shog /'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshul khrims gzhi brten zhing*// yon tan rgya mtsho skye dgu'i nyer 'tsho mchog /dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi// bkra shis rgya mtshos deng 'dir bkra shis shog /bkra shis rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs legs bsgrags pas// sku tshe rgya mtsho bzhin du brtan pa dang*// dpal 'byor rgya mtsho che ltar rgya che zhing*// bstan pa'i rgya mtsho rnam par rgyas byed shog /mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i zhabs la legs gtugs shing*// thos pa rgya mtsho'i nor gyis phyug gyur pa// blo gros rgya mtshos rgyal mtshan dpal zhes pas// bkra shis rgya mtsho mchog 'di rnam par bskyil// 'di ni bkra shis rgya mtsho ste// de nyid bstod tshig rgya mtsho'ang yin// blo gsal rgya mtsho'i yid 'phrog pas// snyan ngag rgya mtsho'ang 'di nyid yin// rgyal po rgyal khams dang bcas pa bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis kyi rgya mtsho rnam par bskyil pa zhes bya ba 'di/ chu mo phag gi lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe bsdebs nas phul ba'o// //na mo gu ru rat+na tra yā ya/ gang mnyes na ni rgyal ba kun mnyes shing*// de mnyes na ni dngos grub kun 'byung ba// bla ma dam pa brgyud par bcas rnams kyi// bkra shis dam pa khyed la sbyin gyur cig /de nyid gzigs pas srid las rnam grol zhing*// thugs rje chen pos zhi la mi gnas pa// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyi// bkra shis dam pa khyed la sbyin gyur cig /chags pa med pas chags bral du byed cing*// bgrod pa gcig lam zab mo nyer zhi ba// dam chos rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa khyod la sbyin gyur cig /tshul gnas thos dang ting nge 'dzin brtson pas// rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtshor mngon gzhol ba// tshogs kyi mchog rab 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi// bkra shis dam pa khyed la sbyin gyur cig

/lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin drang srong dang*// klu dang lha min gnod sbyin dri za sogs// bde 'gro'i dbang po'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa khyod la sbyin gyur cig /sa chu me rlung nyi zla rin chen dang*// bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang sman la sogs// 'byung dang 'byung ba las gyur thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa khyed la sbyin gyur cig /khyad par 'phags pa'i bkra shis yid 'ong ba// bsam pa dge bas shis pa brjod pa yis// sras bcas rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams kun gyis kyang*// 'di yi mthun 'gyur kun nas gsung gyur cig /shing pho byi ba'i lo 'di lo rnams kyi// thog ma yin zhes gtsug lag dag las 'byung*// 'di nyid nas brtsams mi dbang yum sras bcas// bde legs bya phyir bdag gis de skad brjod// rgyal po chen po sras dang*/ btsun mo dang*/ rgyal rgyud dang*/ rgyal srid dang bcas pa thams cad bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ shing pho byi ba'i lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe/ dga' ston gyi kun dga' ra bar/ bkra shis kyi dbyangs kun nas bsgrags pa'i don du/ 'phags pas nye bar bsdebs nas rgyang ring po nas bskur ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems kyi rin chen las 'khrungs shing*// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis bskrun gyur pas// don gnyis brnyes pa'i phrin las grub pa yi// shākya'i rgyal po'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /srid zhi'i rlung gis rnam par mi bskyod pa'i// chos dbyings ye shes pha rol son gyur nas// phrin las rdo rjes bdud dpung nges 'joms pa'i// mi bskyod rdo rje'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /'tshe ba med pa phan bde'i ngang tshul la// gcig tu goms pa'i brtul zhugs mthar phyin pas// tshe dang ye shes dpag med legs brnyes pa'i// tshe dpag med pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog

/dam chos bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba dpag yas kyis// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i thabs brtson pas// skye dgu'i gnyen gcig sman pa'i blar gyur pa'i// sman gyi bla ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi// thugs rje bsdus pa'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba// phrin las chen po 'gag med rol pa can// thugs rje chen po'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /'gro la byams pas byams pa'i ngang tshul can// brtson pa dam pas kun nas ma pham zhing*// phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor ba// byams mgon rgyal ba'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /'gro ba sgrol mdzad sgrol ma khro gnyer can// rme brtsegs 'chol pa rta mchog la sogs pa'i// lha dang lha mo khro bo khro mo'i tshogs// 'phags pa'i rnam 'phrul rnam par bkod rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba che ba'i cher grags pa// go 'phang sna tshogs tshul yang sna tshogs zhing*// bstan la dga' bas bstan pa rab bsrung ba'i// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i pho brang lha sa'i gzhal med kyi// thub pa'i dbang po sras dang slob ma dang*// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis spel ba 'di// rgyal po khyod la 'phags pas ring nas 'bul// shing mo glang gi lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ bod kyi sprul pa'i rgyal po mang po byon pa'i gnas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phel ba'i gzhi/ dpal lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di nye bar spel nas bskur ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ na maḥshrī mān pa ra ma gu tsu tsa ra naṃ ka ma lā ya/ he ru ka dpal ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs// rje btsun grags pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug sogs// bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rnam gzigs gtsug tor can dang thams cad skyob// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srungs dpal// shākya thub sogs phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog

/mdo yi sde dang 'dul ba ma mo dang*// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang de rtogs pa'i// zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pas mdzes rnams dang*// rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong pa dang phyir mi 'ong*// dgra bcom rang rgyal rgyal sras thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /dbyangs dang gsal byed brjod pa kun gyi gzhi// de dag las btus gsang sngags rig sngags dang*// gzungs sngags snying po nye ba'i snying po sogs// skul byed sngags kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma rin chen dang*// sna tshogs rdo rje ral gri ut+pal sogs// don chen mtshon byed phyag mtshan thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /stug po'i zhing dang mi mjed bde ba can// mngon par dga' dang yon tan dpag med sogs// rgyal ba rnams kyis bstan pa'i zhing khams kyi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /rdo rje chos skyong ba dang phyogs skyong dang*// lha dbang klu dbang gnod sbyin lha min dbang*// 'jig rten skyong ba che ba'i che rnams kyi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /yid bzhin nor bu bum bzang dpag bsam shing*// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang grub pa'i ral gri dang*// rdzogs ldan sprin tshogs 'dod dgu sbyin byed pa'i// rdzas mchog rnams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /sa dang chu rlung me dang nyi zla dang*// sman dang lo tog bsam gtan la sogs pa// 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor gyur pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /de ltar gsung rab rin chen gling las shis pa'i tshig gi nor bu'i tshogs// blo gros ded dpon dam pas blangs gang rnam dpyod rdo rjes phug rjes su// ngag gi srad bus nye bar brgyus pa bde legs gsal ba'i 'od 'byin pa'i// bkra shis rin chen phreng ba 'di ni mi dbang nyid la 'phags pas 'bul// me pho stag gi lo gsar pa shar ba bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/

bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di dpal sa skyar rnam par spel nas/ dbang phyug dam pa'i phyag tu 'phags pas ring nas bskur ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dbang gi rgyal po ltar// lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur cing*// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba// bla ma'i bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /shar gyi ri rtser skye dgu'i sgron ma'i dpal// phun sum tshogs pa 'bar bas lha nged ltar// yon tan phrin las 'od stong 'bar ba po// rgyal ba'i bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /rgyu skar khrod na rgyu skar bdag po'i dpal// yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mdzes pa ltar// chags bral chags pa sel ba'i 'od 'byin pa// chos kyi bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /rgya mtsho'i gling na sna tshogs rin chen gyis// rgya mtsho'i rgyal po kun nas 'byor pa ltar// rgyal ba'i 'khor gyis 'byor par gang gyur pa// tshogs kyi bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /skyabs gsum rin chen cod pan gyis mdzes shing*// bslab gsum rin chen drwa ba'i rgyan gyis spras// srid gsum 'gro ba'i sgron ma mchog gyur pa// bshes gnyen rnams kyi bkra shis sbyin gyur cig /de ltar bkra shis dam pa las byung zhing*// bkra shis ngo mtshar rmad kyis phul gyur pa'i// bkra shis brjod pas dpal du 'os pa khyod// rtag tu 'gro ba kun gyi dpal gyur cig /khyod kyi dpal gyi gzi yis phyogs kyi khongs// rgya mtsho'i chu yis sa yi khyon lta bur// khyab par byas nas 'byung po thams cad kyi// rtag tu nye bar 'tshe ba nyid gyur cig /gling bzhir bcas pa'i rgya mtsho'i rgya khyon ni// khor yug ri yis kun nas bcings pa ltar// lha yi dpal dang bcas pa'i rgyal srid kyang*// sangs rgyas mthu yis kun nas srung gyur cig

/bkra shis 'di ni dpal gyi 'byung gnas te// sdeb sbyor byed pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal// bzang po nyid lags lo gsar bde legs phyir// dbang phyug dam pa'i dpal la gus pas 'bul// lo gsar 'di ni me mo yos lags te// 'phags pa'i yul du rab byung zhes byar grags// rab byung 'di ni lo yi thog ma ste// 'di nas brtsams te kun du bde legs shog /me mo yos bu'i lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa spel nas mi'i dbang po'i phyag tu bskur ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa rgya che zhing*// ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i ye shes rab zab la// dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje kun 'jug pa// bla ma mchog la btud nas shis pa brjod// gang las phan bde'i dpal 'byor kun 'byung zhing*// srid zhi'i nyes pa ma lus drungs 'byin pa// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mdzad pa legs bsgrub pa// mtshungs med bla ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /byang chub lam gyis byang chub brnyes gyur cing*// kun dga'i chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed mdzad pa// rkang gnyis dbang po zla gnyis mi mnga' ba// rgyal ba'i bkra shis dam pas rgyal gyur cig /gsung rab dam pa dam pa las brgyud cing*// rtog pa dge ba dge ba'i 'byung gnas mchog /zhi mdzad zhi bar gyur pa dam chos kyi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /dam pas dam pa'i lam la zhugs gyur cing*// dge bas dge ba'i go 'phang mchog bsgrub par// gcig tu 'dun pa'i 'dun pa rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi bkra shis dam pas bkra shis shog /chos dang dam chos 'dzin pa gang yin pa// de dag skyong zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes nas// sgrub po'i 'dod don ma lus sgrub mdzad pa// chos skyong rnams kyis kun nas skyong gyur cig

/'jig rten skyong ba 'jig rten don gnyer zhing*// che ba'i che bar kun la grags gyur la// rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul can// 'jig rten skyong bas lhag par skyong gyur cig /rgyal po sras dang btsun mo srid bcas rnams// rgyal bar bya phyir 'phags pa'i blo gros las// rgyal ba'i gsung gi tshul dang rjes mthun par// rgyal bar byed pa'i shis pa 'di byung ngo*// sa pho 'brug gi lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis rnam par spel nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag sbyar nas/ rgyal po yab yum sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar bskur ba 'di ni sa pho 'brug gi lo smal po'i zla ba la 'dam gyi sa'i char bris pa phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ //oṃ swa sti sid+dha/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba gang zhig 'od dang dpal yon gyi// 'byung gnas dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal nas// phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba yi// bkra shis dam pa 'di ni brjod par bya// mi mjed zhes bya'i 'jig rten khams kyi mgon// dpal dang ldan zhing brtse ba chen po pa// skyob pa shākya thub pa zhes bya ba'i// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /shar gyi phyogs kyi rgyal ba'i zhing khams ni// nyon mongs thams cad bskyod par gang bzhugs pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes spyad ces bya ba'i// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /lho phyogs mun pa mun nag tshogs bcom par// dang po sems bskyed yid mdzad rnam grags pa// bsnyengs bral mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po yi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /nub kyi phyogs kyi thub pa'i zhing khams ni// kun nas yul phebs zhes bya'i chos kyi rgyal// thub pa 'khon dang rgyags pa rnam gnon pa'i// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /byang gi phyogs na rnam par gnas pa'i zhing*// sangs rgyas rnams kyi spobs pa can zhes bya// thub pa rin chen gzugs bkod 'od gnon gyi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog

/byang shar 'jig rten bdud kyi sde bcom par// byang chub shing dbang drung du rnam 'phrul ba// bdud dang yid gnyis kun 'joms rnam gnon pa'i// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /shar lho'i 'jig rten rtag tu snang ba ni// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang po sems bskyed pas// phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo 'byung dpal gyi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /lho nub phyogs na gnas pa'i 'jig rten khams// gser gyi drwa bas g.yogs pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon// rin chen gdugs 'phags snang zhes bya ba yi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /nub byang mtshams su bkod pa thub pa'i zhing*// yongs dag rab gnas mngon 'phags zhes bya bar// rgyal ba byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba yi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /steng gi 'jig rten dmigs pa med pa'i don// yid la byed pa can du skrag med pa// mun bral ting 'dzin mngon 'phags rgyal po yi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /'og gi zhing khams yon tan thams cad kyis// brgyan par dang po sems bskyed the tshom kun// gcod mdzad nyon mongs bskyod ces bya ba yi// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /gang sngon mtshan mchog 'di dag thos gyur pa'i// srog chags stong du tshang ba de dag kun// gaṅgā klung gi bye snyed tshe rabs su// 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal rgyas thob pa'i mthar// bskal pa gcig la zhing khams gcig nyid du// rim gyis sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba ni// dag pa'i spyan gyis brgyan pa zhes bya'o// de dag kun gyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gzhan yang dus gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// thub pa'i dbang po sras dang slob mar bcas// chos dang dpal dang 'od kyis lham me ba// de dag kun gyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /bkra shis mchog gi kun nas shis gyur pa'i// bkra shis dam pa'i shis pa brjod pa 'di// bkra shis du mas kun nas 'byor gyur pa// bkra shis brtan pa nyid la 'bul zhing mchis// rgyal po chen po/

sras dang*/ btsun mo/ srid 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di// 'phags pas bsdebs nas sa mo sbrul gyi lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe phul ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa// bkra shis 'byung gnas la btud de// bkra shis kun gyis shis bya'i phyir// bkra shis rnam par spel ba brjod// dag snang yul gyi pho brang du// skal pa bzhin du snang gyur cing*// mos pa ji bzhin 'dren mdzad pa'i// bla ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rdo rje 'chang dpal bdag med ma// bir+wa kṛṣ+ṇa ḍā ma pa// gnyis spangs ga ya dha ra dpal// shākya ye shes kun rig dang*// chos 'bar rje btsun snying po'i zhabs// rtse mo'i zhabs dang rgyal mtshan mtha'// chos rje bzang po'i zhabs sogs kyi// bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du// gnyis med dag pa gnyis ldan zhing*// dus gsum rgyal ba kun bskyed pa'i// chos sku'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub// brjod du med cing bgrang du med// rnam dbye med pa'i chos nyid can// bsam mi khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su// bde chen nges pa lnga ldan zhing*// chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pa'i// bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /bsam mi khyab pa'i gnas brnyes kyang*// sngon las rjes su 'brang ba'i phyir// rgyu yi rgyud grangs ji snyed pa// de snyed rnams kyis bkra shis shog /sna tshogs bkod pa'i zhing khams su// sna tshogs rnam par 'phrul pa yi// sna tshogs pa yis don mdzad pa'i// sprul sku'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /longs spyod rdzogs pa gcig las kyang*// gnas yul dus dang rnam pa yis// rnam pa du mar rab snang ba// sprul pa mang po'i bkra shis shog

/rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub dang*// 'od srungs shākya thub mchog dpal// byams pa seng ge rab gsal sogs// dus gsum gshegs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs gyur pa'i// rkang gnyis gtso bo thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen 'byung*// dpag med don yod grub la sogs// dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtsor gyur pa// sprul pa mchog gi bkra shis shog /rdo rje rin chen chos dang ni// las kyi sems ma la sogs pa// phyag rgya'i gzugs su gang gnas nas// rgyal ba mnyes par byed pa dang*// gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi// gtso mo nyid du gang gyur pa// rig pa'i rgyal mo thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /byams pa sa yi snying po dang*// sgrib pa rnam sel kun tu bzang*// phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha'i snying po 'jam dbyangs sogs// sems dpa' mchog gi tshul bzung dang*// rang gi sa la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /sgeg mo phreng ba glu ma gar// bdug spos me tog mar me ma// dri chab ma sogs mchod pa yi// lha mo rnams kyi bkra shis shog /gshin rje mthar byed shes mthar byed// pad+ma mthar byed bgegs mthar byed// mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon can// stobs chen gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur// hūm̐ mdzad la sogs khro bo yi// rgyal po rnams kyi bkra shis shog /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dang*// rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa'i// pho nya mngag pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /gdung ba rnam sel yid myur sogs// bse ru rwa yi tshul 'dzin dang*// de bzhin tshogs na spyod pa yi// rang rgyal rnams kyi bkra shis shog /kauṇ+ḍi n+ya 'od srungs dang*// shā ri'i bu dang maung gal sogs// dgra bcom dbang po thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog

/'dod par lan cig phyir 'ong dang*// gang dag phyir mi 'ong ba dang*// rgyun zhugs de dag zhugs pa dang*// 'bras bur gnas pas phye ba ste// 'phags pa'i gang zag brgyad rnams kyi// bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /rdo rje nag po chen po dang*// dpal gyi lha mo la sogs pa// chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /phyogs skyong ba dang lha chen dang*// klu dbang gza' dang rgyu skar sogs// 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /de ltar bkra shis rnam par spel ba 'di// sa bdag sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams// dge bar bya phyir lcags pho rta yi lo// gsar pa shar tshe 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar// phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// chos nyid gzigs pa sgrib med pa'i// chos kyi spyan dang ldan rnams la// chos kyi tshul bzhin phyag 'tshal nas// chos bzhin shis pa brjod par bya// chos kyi dbang phyug kun rang bzhin// chos kyi dpal gyis 'byor gyur zhing*// chos las skyes pa kun skyed pa// chos rje bla ma'i bkra shis shog /chos kyi dbyings las byung gyur zhing*// chos nyid zab mos rab phye bas// chos kyi mnga' bdag mchog gyur pa// chos mdzad rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos kyi 'byung gnas las byung ba'i// chos don phun sum tshogs gyur pas// chos min rnam par sun 'byin pa'i// chos kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /chos rjes 'brang ba'i yid ldan pa// chos kyi rje yis rjes bskyangs pas// chos kyi rgya mtshor nyer zhugs pa// chos ldan rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos kyi mnga' dbang brnyes pa gang*// chos kyi rgyal por rab bsgos nas// chos dang chos 'dzin kun srung ba// chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos lam dge ba spyad pa yis// chos tshul mngon par mthong ba yi// chos ldan 'jig rten skyong ba yis// chos bzhin bkra shis sbyin gyur cig

/chos dbyings spros las rnam grol yang*// chos can sna tshogs kun snang ba// chos rnam gnyis kyi bden pa'i mthus// chos tshul 'gro la gsal gyur cig /chos dang chos nyid ji snyed don rnams ji bzhin gang gis thugs chud pas// chos dang chos min rnam dbye'i phyogs la shin tu mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can// chos rje chos rgyal sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i 'od zer gsal ldan pa'i// chos drin chos bzhin nye bar thob pa'i chos 'dzin 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar// 'di yi tshig dang de bzhin don gnyis ka /chos kyi tshul yin gzhan yang de bzhin du// chos nyid zab mo'i sgo la 'jug byed pas// bkra shis 'di ni chos kyi rgya mtsho yin// gang dag gis ni shis pa 'di brjod dang*// 'di yis gang la shis pa byas gyur pa// de dag bkra shis rgya mtsho'i dge mtshan gyis// kun nas shis par 'gyur ba snyam du'ang bsam// lcags mo lug gi lo nas brtsams nas su// lo rnams thams cad kun nas shis bya'i phyir// bdag gis bkra shis nye bar brjod 'di la// rgyal ba'i tshogs kyis mthun 'gyur brjod gyur cig /lcags mo lug gi lo gsar pa shar ba bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnam par spel nas rgyal po chen po la phul ba'o// phyogs dang dus thams cad du shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig/ //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// skyob pa 'od dang rdzu 'phrul chen po pa// mngon par shes pa sgrib pa med pa po// mi 'gyur mi 'gag rgyun mi 'chad pa can// sangs rgyas bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /mtshan dang mthun pa'i dpe byad rab 'bar zhing*// don dang mthun pa'i tshig 'bru rnam dag pa// mkhyen dang mthun pa'i brtse ba chen po pa// sangs rgyas bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /nam mkha' ji bzhin 'jig rten mtha' yas shing*// 'jig rten ji bzhin sems can bgrang yas la// de bzhin phrin las pha mtha' yas pa po// sangs rgyas bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig

/mngon par mtho dang nges par 'byin pa'i lam// ngag tshig dri med seng ge'i sgra dbyangs kyis// bsnyems bral kun tu rnam par bsgrags pa yi// chos kyi bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /brtul zhugs bzang po thos pa'i nor ldan dang*// de bzhin 'phags pa'i gang zag brgyad rnams dang*// rgyal sras rgyal ba'i rgya mtshor nyer gzhol ba// dge 'dun bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /rdo rje chos skyong chos kyi gzi yis lham// 'jig rten skyong ba 'jig rten dpal dang ldan// drang srong drang pos brtul zhugs ldan rnams kyi// bkra shis dam pas skye dgu bkra shis shog /sa chu me rlung nyi ma zla ba dang*// nor bu dpag bsam shing dang bum bzang dang*// sngags dang sman gyi dge ba'i mthu rnams kyis// snod dang bcas pa'i skye dgu bde legs shog /chu pho spre'u'i lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe bkra shis par bya ba'i don du bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag rnam par spel nas/ rgyal po chen po btsun mo sras dang bcas pa la/ 'phags pas phul ba 'di ni lcags mo lug gi lo// zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin par shing kun gyi mkhar du sbyar ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma dang*// skyabs mchog dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas// rgyal po rgyal srid bcas pa bde legs phyir// bkra shis rnam par brjod pa 'di la gson// gnyis med ye shes rgya mtshor nyer 'khrungs shing*// chos dbyings gzigs pa sgrib pa med pa can// sbyin pa dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor ba// rab dga'i sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /sgo gsum dge ba'i spyod pa lhun grub pas// sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i brtul zhugs bzang ldan zhing*// tshul khrims dag pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor pa// dri med sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog

/rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho nyer bzung nas// lung gi chos kyi 'od 'bum 'gyed mdzad cing*// bzod pa dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor pa// 'od byed sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /rtogs pa dam pa'i ye shes me 'bar bas// nyes tshogs tshang tshing kun nas sreg byed cing*// brtson 'grus dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor pa// 'od 'phro'i sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /byang chub spyod pa shin tu rmad byung bas// rang gi gdul bya yongs su smin byed cing*// bsam gtan dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor pa// sbyang dka'i sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /yang dag shes pas zhi ba mngon gyur kyang*// brtse ba chen pos 'gro la rjes chags shing*// shes rab dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor pa// mngon gyur sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /'khor ba'i chos las ring du 'phags gyur cing*// rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtshor nyer gzhol ba// yang dag thabs kyi tshul la dbang 'byor pa// ring song sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /mnyam pa nyid du mngon par byang chub nas// srid zhi'i rtog pas rnam par mi bsgul zhing*// smon lam dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor pa// mi g.yo'i sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /so so yang dag rig pa bzhi brnyes nas// chos kyi 'khor lo kun nas legs bskor zhing*// stobs mchog dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor pa// blo gros legs par gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes nas// 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur legs thob cing*// ye shes dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor pa// chos kyi sprin la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /rdo rje lta bu'i rdo rje'i thugs brnyes nas// gnyis su med pas gnyis la legs bzhugs pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdzogs pa'i dpal mnga' ba'i// bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /de ltar bkra shis rnam par spel ba 'dis// mi dbang sras dang srid sder bcas pa kun// chu mo bya yi lo la brtsams nas kyang*// shis par bya phyir 'phags pas rnam par spel// 'di shing kun du//

//oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sa la dbang ba mi yi rje// sras dang de dag btsun mor bcas// rgyud bcas 'bangs dang bcas rnams la// bkra shis dam pa gsol bar bgyi// rang rig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su// gang gi mthu yis mngon byed pa// bla ma dam pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /phyogs bcu dag gi zhing rnams na// dus gsum du ni bzhugs gyur pa'i// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /de dag kun gyi gsung rab dang*// de don bsgoms pas kun chub pa// lung dang rtogs pa'i chos rnams kyi// bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /rkang gnyis gtso bo'i dbang rnams kyi// thugs dang chos las 'khrungs gyur pa// sras dang slob ma'i tshogs rnams kyi// bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /chos skyong chos kyi gzi yis lham// chos min rnam par sun 'byin pa// rdo rje chos skyong thams cad kyi// bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /grub pa rig 'dzin lha yi rje// klu dbang lha min dbang po sogs// 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi// bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /nor bu bum bzang dpag bsam shing*// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang grub pa'i bcud// sman dang sngags sogs thams cad kyi// bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /shing pho khyi zhes bya ba yi// lo gsar shar ba nas brtsams nas// dus rnams kun tu shis bya'i phyir// bkra shis dge slong 'phags pas spel// phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bla na med pa'i bla ma dang*// phyag bgyir 'os la phyag 'tshal nas// shis pa kun gyis shis bya ba// khyod ni shis pas shis par bgyi// rig stong zung 'jug las byung zhing*// thabs dang shes rab mthar phyin pas// sku gnyis zung 'jug brnyes pa po// sangs rgyas bkra shis deng 'dir shog

/ye shes rgya mtsho las byung ba'i// lung gi lam gyi dpal bskyed nas// 'gog pa'i bden pas nyer zhi ba// chos kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /bdag dang sems can kun gyi sems// nye bar zhi bar nyer gzigs nas// phyir mi ldog pa'i dpal brnyes pa// dge 'dun bkra shis deng 'dir shog /chos khams rab tu zhi ba las byung zhing*// nye bar zhi bas zhi ba'i lam bstan pa// zhi ba rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor can// rin chen dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /sems nyid gdod nas 'od gsal ba// dri ma kun gyis ma rnyogs shing*// thog mtha' med cing g.yung drung ba// khams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gdod nas nye bar zhi ba'i dbyings// glo bur rtog las rnam grol zhing*// yon tan rgya mtsho'i rten gyur pa// byang chub bkra shis deng 'dir shog /srid pa'i lam gyis yongs bsgyur bas// bral dang rnam par smin pa yis// rang dang gzhan gyi don brnyes pa// yon tan bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rnam par mi rtog lhun gyi grub// yul dus rnam pa mtha' yas pa'i// mdzad pas gdul bya'i don bsgrub pa// phrin las bkra shis deng 'dir shog /dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang dri ma med// dri med sangs rgyas yon tan rgyal ba'i mdzod// gang la dkon mchog dge ba gsum 'byung ba// don dam gzigs pa'i yul gyi bkra shis shog /de ltar rigs dang rigs las byung ba yi// dkon mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis rab brjod pas// rgyal po sras dang srid 'bangs bcas pa kun// bkra shis phun sum tshogs shing zhabs brtan shog /shing mo phag gi lo gsar pa shar ba nas brtsams nas phyogs dang dus thams cad bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ dkon mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis rnam par spel ba zhes bya ba 'di/ 'bal gyi sa'i char dge slong 'phags pas spel nas bskur ba'o// //bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnam par spel ba zhes bya ba/

bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma dang*// skyob mchog dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas// rgyal po sras dang srid sder bcas pa kun// bde legs bya phyir shis pa 'di brjod do// bla mar 'os pa gang zhig bla ma dang*// mchod 'os brjod 'os nyid du bkur bgyis pas// de yang de 'dra nyid du des mdzad pa// bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gang gi sku ni dpal gyis 'bar ba ste// de yi gsung yang bden pa'i dpal gyis brjid// thugs ni mkhyen brtse'i dpal gyis phun tshogs pa// sangs rgyas dpal gyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /yi ge ngag tshig rnam par dag pa yis// mtshon du med pa'i don yang mtshon byed na// mtshon bya kun tu mtshon pa ci smos pa'i// dam pa'i chos kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /re res kyang ni lhar bcas zil gnon na// 'tshogs pa'i gzi yis smos kyang ci 'tshal ba// nye bar zhi ba 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i sprin// tshogs kyi dam pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rdo rje chos skyong rdo rje'i ngang tshul can// gcig pu sra mkhregs rang 'dra'i sde dang bcas// rgyal ba mchod cing rgyal sras legs skyong ba// chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /lha dang lha dbang grub pa'i rig 'dzin dang*// klu dang klu dbang lha min mi'am ci// gnod sbyin 'dab bzangs tshogs rje tshogs bdag sogs// 'jig rten skyong ba'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gang na 'jigs med seng ge'i sgra sgrogs dang*// gang du mthu chen glang po'i stobs 'chang ba// de dag kun gyis grol ba'i dregs bcom nas// dbang phyug dam pa'i dbang phyug skyong gyur cig /'di ltar me pho byi ba'i lo gsar pa shar ba nas brtsams nas/ dus thams cad du rgyal po yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas shing*/ srid 'bangs dang bcas pa bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/

bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di/ shing mo phag gi lo smal po'i zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin par tsom mdo'i gtsug lag khang du spel nas bskur ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ don thams cad grub pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// don grub bsam pa grub pa po// chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// don grub shis pa brjod par bya// rdo rje slob dpon yon tan mtsho// dpal kun gyi ni 'byung gnas te// don kun grub par mdzad pa po// bla ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /tshogs gnyis tshogs ni rab bsags pas// rang gi don kun grub gyur nas// gzhan gyi don yang 'grub mdzad pa// sangs rgyas bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rgyal ba don kun grub pa yi// ye shes rgya mtsho las byung zhing*// gang gis bsnyen pa'i don grub pa'i// rin chen chos kyi bkra shis shog /don kun grub pa'i rjes zhugs nas// gzhan gyi don la nyer gzhol bas// gnyis ka'i don kun legs bsgrubs pa// dge 'dun bkra shis deng 'dir shog /thub pa don kun legs grub pa'i// gsung gis ma lus chos kyi don// sgrub par bsgos bzhin legs bsgrub pa'i// chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bsod nams dpal gyi gzis bskrun pas// rang gi mngon mtho'i don grub nas// gzhan dag la yang dpal stsol ba// 'jig rten skyong ba'i bkra shis shog /ma grub pa rnams 'grub byed cing*// grub pa rnams kyi dpal skyed pa// grub pa rnams dang rig 'dzin gyi// bkra shis dam pa deng 'dir shog /gang gi mthu yis de ston pa'i// don kun yid bzhin 'grub byed pa// nor bu dpag bsam shing sogs kyi// bkra shis dam pa deng 'dir shog /de ltar ma lus don kun 'grub byed pa'i// bkra shis rmad du byung ba legs brjod pas// dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa lha khyod kyi// bzhed don thams cad chos bzhin 'grub gyur cig

/khyod kyi sras sogs khyod kyi rig 'dzin dang*// btsun mo dam pa rnams dang de bzhin du// blon po mchog sogs khyod kyi rtsa lag kun// mchog tu tshe ring ba dang dpal rgyas shog /'gro ba 'di dag zang zing dpal gyis 'byor// chos kyi dpal gyis lhag par yid zhi zhing*// snod kyang sman dang 'bru dang rin chen sogs// 'jig rten nyer 'tsho byed pas gang bar shog /me mo glang gi lo gsar pa shar ba nas brtsams nas kyang*// rgyal po chen po sras dang*/ btsun mo dang*/ srid 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ don thams cad grub pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba 'di/ me pho byi ba'i lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i nyi shu lnga la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por 'phags pas sbyar nas bskur ba'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bkra shis rnam par spel ba'i tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la bkra shis phun tshogs shing*// de las bkra shis kun 'byung ba// bkra shis phul byung rgyal ba la// btud nas bkra shis 'di brjod do// 'dod dgu'i dpal kun 'byung phyir dang*// sgrub po'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur cing*// bla ma rin chen lta bu ste// de yi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /stobs sogs sangs rgyas chos rnams kun// 'byung phyir sangs rgyas rin chen ni// rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu ste// de yi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /nyon mongs gdung ba sel phyir dang*// dge ba'i lo tog rgyu mtshan phyir// chos ni sprin chen lta bu ste// de yi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /dpag yas 'byung ba'i nyer 'tsho dang*// 'dus pa zab cing rgya che'i phyir// dge 'dun 'dus pa lta bu ste// de yi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /de ltar skyabs kyi mchog gyur dkon mchog gis// mi dbang khyod ni nye bar bskyabs pa yis// rtag tu nyam nga'i gnas rnams kun las khyod// kun tu bsnyengs bral lham mer bzhugs gyur cig

/de dag gis ni mi mthun phyogs rnams kun// rnam par bcom nas sku tshe'i dpal brnyes te// nongs mi mnga' bar 'jig rten thams cad kyi// nyer 'tsho nyid du rtag tu bzhugs gyur cig /skyob pa'i dpal gyis nyid kyi dpal 'phel nas// bdag dang gzhan gyi dpal min rnams bsal te// chos kyi dpal dang 'jig rten dpal 'byung bas// rtag tu 'gro ba'i dpal du bzhugs gyur cig /dpal 'byor gang 'dras bdag dpal 'di 'dra zhes// ga zha dang ni glu dbyangs sgrogs pa yi// sgra yis gzhan don dgyes pa'i ngang tshul can// rgyal sras rnams kyi snyan gyi dpal gyur cig /de ltar dpal gyis dpal du byed pa yis// bkra shis 'di yis dpal du 'os pa khyod// dpal du bya phyir blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal// bzang pos bsdebs nas lha yi phyag tu phul// sa pho stag gi lo gsar pa shar nas bskur ba'o// //phyogs dang dus thams cad du bde legs su byed pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi drin gyis mngon par mtho ba dang*// rnam par grol ba'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa// bde blag stsol mdzad bla ma la btud de// rgyal po khyod la shis pa 'di brjod do// mi mjed 'jig rten khams kyi rnam 'dren mchog /shākya thub pa dpal gyis lham me ba// sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /shar phyogs rin chen yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi// rnam par 'dren pa rin chen 'byung gnas ni// sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /lho phyogs mya ngan med pa'i 'jig rten gyi// rnam par 'dren pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal// sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /nub phyogs nye bar zhi ba'i 'jig rten gyi// rnam par 'dren pa rin chen 'od 'phro ni// sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog

/byang phyogs rnam par rgyal ba'i 'jig rten gyi// rnam par 'dren pa rgyal ba'i dbang po ni// sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /byang shar ting 'dzin gyis brgyan 'jig rten gyi// rnam 'dren ting 'dzin glang po dam pa'i dpal// sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /shar lho snying po byang chub rgyan zhes pa'i// rnam par 'dren pa pad+mo dam pa'i dpal// sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /lho nub rdul dang bral ba'i 'jig rten gyi// rnam 'dren nyi ma snang ba dam pa'i dpal// sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /nub byang dbang du gyur pa'i 'jig rten gyi// rnam par 'dren pa gdugs mchog ces bya ba// sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /'og phyogs pad+ma can gyi 'jig rten gyi// rnam par 'dren pa sangs rgyas pad+mo'i dpal// sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /steng phyogs mdangs dga' zhes bya'i 'jig rten gyi// rnam par 'dren pa sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal// sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /gzhan yang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gang byon dang*// da ltar bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad dang*// slad nas 'byon 'gyur thub dbang thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /de ltar dus gsum phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi// bkra shis brjod pas rgyal dbang dam pa ni// sras dang de dag btsun mo brgyud pa dang*// rgyal srid bcas pa rtag tu bkra shis shog /mi mthun phyogs rnams rang gi ngang gis zhi// chos dang zang zing dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs// snod rnams thams cad bdud rtsi'i bcud dang ldan// lha rnams kun gyis rtag tu skyong gyur cig

/de ltar sa mo yos kyi lo gsar pa shar nas kyang dus rtag tu bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ rgyal po chen po'i spyan sngar bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di 'phags pa zhes bya bas sa pho stag gi lo/ smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes bdun la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por spel nas bskur ba'o// // ༄༅// bkra shis su bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// thub dang chos kyi rgyal po 'jig rten mkhyen// thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten phan dgongs pa// 'jig rten rnam 'dren phyogs bcur bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rgyal ba rgya mtshos mngon par chub gyur cing*// brtse ba rgya mtshos kun nas dag mdzad pas// skye dgu rgya mtsho'i tshogs la rab bstan pa// dam chos rgya mtsho'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gang sngon byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// rgya chen bskyed pa byams pas rab bskrun pas// byams pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya che rab rgyas pa// mi pham byams pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /skye dgu 'jigs las skyob dang yon tan gyi// rten gyur sa rnams kun la rab brten pas// gnyis med ye shes snying po'i dpal mnga' ba// sa yi snying po'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gang la gang gis bsgribs pa'i sgrib pa kun// nam mkha' nyid bzhin gzigs pa nyid kyis sgrib// rnam par bsal nas gzhan sgrib sel mdzad pa// sgrib pa rnam sel bkra shis deng 'dir shog /nyid thugs kun tu bzang po'i ngang gyur pa// chos kun kun nas bzang por gzigs gyur te// 'gro kun kun tu bzang por sgrub mdzad pa// kun tu bzang po'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gang thugs gnyis med ye shes rdo rje'i mthus// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rab bcom nas// rgyal ba sras bcas bsrung ba'i phyir brtson pa// phyag na rdo rje'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog

/'gro kun thugs rje goms pas thugs rje yi// ngang du gyur pas sems can kun skyob cing*// de mtshan thos pas bde ba'i dpal rgyas pa// spyan ras gzigs kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /chos kun nam mkha'i rang bzhin mkhyen gyur pas// nam mkha' ji bzhin nyid thugs rnam dag nas// chos rnams kun gyi snying por gang gyur pa// nam mkha'i snying po'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mkhyen rab gcig bsdus pa// rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i gtso bor 'phrul mdzad nas// shes rab dam pa'i go 'phang stsol mdzad pa// 'jam pa'i dpal gyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gzhan yang rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang*// slob dang mi slob 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// chos skyong 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pas bkra shis deng 'dir shog /de ltar bkra shis ngo mtshar dpal gyi phul// nye bar bkod nas sa bdag sras bcas la// phul bas bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa khyed// lhun po ji bzhin rtag tu zhabs brtan shog /lcags pho 'brug gi lo gsar pa shar ba nas bzung ste/ rgyal po chen po yab sras rgyal srid dang bcas pa bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di sa mo yos bu'i lo/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco lnga la/ 'phags pa zhes bya bas dpal sa skyar sbyar nas phul ba'o// //dpal ldan khyed sku lhun po ltar brtan zhing*// phrin las nyi ma'i 'od ltar phyogs kun khyab// dpag bsam shing ltar gzhan yid rdzogs par byed// gsum po de yis rgyal sras rgyal gyur cig /shin tu bkra shis so// //oṃ ye dharma he ta pra bha wā he tun+te ṣīnya ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba bid+yā swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
